purpose: Add the missing plain Mamba-1 baseline to the frozen Electricity/Traffic H96 relation-auxiliary-only candidate comparison.
research_question: Does the relation-auxiliary-only MambaTSv3 candidate remain competitive with a same-budget plain Mamba-1 baseline on Electricity and Traffic H96?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory continuation. Every job skips the test loader; no test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or test release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: This matrix isolates a plain Mamba-1 comparator only. It does not establish held-out accuracy, universal superiority, or independent AutoCon causality.

required_before_launch: verify Electricity and Traffic fingerprints and exact 6-job expansion
freeze plain Mamba-1 settings and seeds

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Plain Mamba-1 model, data split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, normalization, and seeds are fixed before launch; no candidate or test result may alter them.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: Plain Mamba-1 shares the candidate's chronological split, M features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epochs, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: Mamba1 receives no AutoCon, representation-fusion, ACF-memory, or candidate-only setting.

phases.name: mamba1_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Same-budget plain Mamba-1 baseline on Electricity and Traffic H96.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Compare means and paired seed deltas only after the strict reader confirms identical source snapshot and frozen coordinates.

stopping_rules: Do not produce or inspect held-out artifacts.
Do not infer AutoCon causality from the candidate/plain Mamba-1 contrast alone.
